content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely contractual under an ICMR-funded extramural research project for a duration of 3 years. The initial contract is valid for a period of 6 months or until project completion, whichever is earlier, and is renewable annually based on performance. Remuneration consists of a consolidated monthly pay along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 10% (₹5,600 for Project Research Scientist-I; ₹2,800 for Technical Support-III; ₹2,000 for Technical Support-II; and ₹1,800 for Technical Support-I). Only consolidated salary and specified HRA are admissible; no additional allowances or facilities are provided.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application proforma provided in Annexure-1 of the official notification. Fill out all columns of the application form correctly with required personal and educational details. Compile a single, consolidated, and scanned PDF of the signed application form along with all required enclosures and supporting documents. Send the scanned PDF via email to [email protected] on or before 31 October 2026. Bring a duly completed hard copy of the application form along with all original certificates, documents, and one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of document verification and interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a written examination or interview, or both, as determined by the Recruitment Committee. Candidates will be shortlisted based on essential and desirable qualifications, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. The interview is scheduled for 3 November 2026, 10:00 AM onwards at the Departmental Seminar Hall, Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine, AIIMS Rishikesh. Selected candidates must join within 5 working days from the date of result declaration.

faq.question: Q1. Is this job at AIIMS Rishikesh permanent?
faq.answer: No, this position is purely contractual under an ICMR-funded project and does not constitute permanent employment with AIIMS Rishikesh.

faq.answer: Only the consolidated monthly salary and HRA (at 10%) are admissible; no additional allowances or facilities will be provided.

faq.question: Q3. What is the contract duration for these project posts?
faq.answer: The contract is valid for a period of 6 months or until the completion of the project, whichever is earlier, and is renewable annually based on performance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required email address for submitting the application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to [email protected] on or before 31 October 2026.
